create_FairChemModel_from_pretrained: create a FairChemModel from a pretrained model name to compute energies and forces on SimState inputs
create_FairChemModel_from_checkpoint: create a FairChemModel from a checkpoint file path to compute atomistic properties with optional stress calculation
run_FairChemModel_forward: run the FairChemModel forward pass on a SimState to get energy, forces, and stress predictions
convert_simstate_to_atomicdata: convert a torch-sim SimState to a batched AtomicData object for use with FairChem predictor models
review_FairChemModel_init: review the FairChemModel init to understand device, dtype, and stress computation configuration options
